name: repo-ai
description: The ai-loop pipeline split out of @rtorcato/repo-tooling: skills that take an ai-ready GitHub issue to a reviewed PR.

plugins.name: repo-ai
plugins.description: Four skills: ai-loop (the entry point and engine), ai-issue (the on-ramp), ai-loop-status (a read-only view) and ai-loop-stop (stop this repo's loop). They call the @rtorcato/repo-ai CLI via npx. Unversioned: tracks main.

plugins.name: release-guard
plugins.description: Opt-in mod: denies agent tool calls that would release outside CI — npm publish, version bumps, local semantic-release, git tags, force pushes, git push --tags/--follow-tags, release workflow dispatches, and package.json version edits. Early-access mod API (Claude Code 2.1.292+). Unversioned: tracks main.

plugins.name: loop-watch
plugins.description: Experimental, optional: a live ai-loop view for Claude Code (status line, /loop-watch pane, merge-ready toast, agent dock). Built on the early-access mod API, so it may break between Claude Code releases. Not installed by repo-ai setup or fix. Pinned to a release commit, so a push to main never changes installed code.

plugins.name: repo-ai-rainbow
plugins.description: A colorful band above the prompt with open ai-* label counts and the ai-loop status; /repo-ai refreshes it. Needs gh. Pinned to a release commit, so a push to main never changes installed code.
